Diagnosis.submission: The order-processing pipeline in the astronomy-shop namespace is stalled. A malformed/truncated JSON record exists in the Kafka topic 'orders-fulfillment' at offset 20: {"order_id":"ORD-100020","amount": (missing value and closing brace). The 'orders-validator' consumer (deployment orders-validator, using scripts from ConfigMap orders-pipeline-scripts consumer.py) treats any invalid record as fatal: in its exception handler it logs 'record validation failed' and 'partition processing paused', then sleeps forever without committing or advancing. Root cause: the consumer has no poison-message handling, so a single corrupt record permanently blocks the partition. Evidence: orders-validator logs show it processed ORD-100000..ORD-100019 (committed_offset up to 20), then errored at offset=20 and repeatedly logs 'partition remains paused at offset=20'; the downstream 'orders-processed' topic is stuck at 20 records while 'orders-fulfillment' keeps growing (89+ records), so fulfilment/accounting never receives later orders. Faulty component: orders-validator (consumer.py) plus the poisoned record at offset 20 of orders-fulfillment.
